comments.author: @SamSam-xo8hs
comments.text: I didn't realize how satirical it was though until I watched it! If you're watching this trailer and thinking that it is placing these characters on pedestals, you might actually enjoy the movie. It's a lot smarter than it looks is what I'm saying. There was a lot to unpack after.

comments.author: @maetheforcebewithyou03
comments.text: i wasn’t sure if i was gonna like this movie but honestly it was really fun and didn’t take itself too seriously which i enjoyed. there’s a difference between middle-aged screenwriters not knowing how to write gen z well and consciously making a parody of it. surprisingly i also really liked the ending, it was unexpected to me. overall a fun, silly yet well-produced comedy thriller. there were many moments where the characters acted more realistically in their circumstances than in most other horror movies so that i oftentimes sat there and thought “same.” can overall recommend, this movie is what “they/them” wanted to be
